programme.title: Sweet 16
programme.desc: Narrated by Norman Fell, this anthology follows three seemingly unconnected individuals as each of their lives are disrupted by anomalous entities. Alex buys a talking antique car that has very exorbitant demands. Frank makes friends with a cultivating mold man that lives in his refrigerator. Susan contacts a dating agency, but the man that they set her up with turns out to be a bit stiff.

programme.title: Straight A's
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: Court TV LIVE: The Deadly Ride Home Trial 1235
programme.desc: It was a love triangle that turned deadly. In 2009, a Florida teenager stabbed her teenaged love rival over an ex-boyfriend, and the case had people across the country glued to the televised trial. When Rachel Wade's claims of self-defense were rejected by a jury, she was convicted and sentenced to prison. With her heinous crime now years in the past. Wade reflects on the misguided teenager she once was and what led her to take another girl's life.

programme.title: Sweet 16
programme.desc: Narrated by Norman Fell, this anthology follows three seemingly unconnected individuals as each of their lives are disrupted by anomalous entities. Alex buys a talking antique car that has very exorbitant demands. Frank makes friends with a cultivating mold man that lives in his refrigerator. Susan contacts a dating agency, but the man that they set her up with turns out to be a bit stiff.

programme.title: mareTV: Wismar Bay
programme.desc: Wide open heaths, windswept and barren in winter, are transformed into wonderful carpets of white, fluffy cotton grass in summer. Large bears and wolves roam alongside delicately fluttering butterflies, the bubbling calls of black grouse and the enchanting trills of the great snipe. Moors, bogs and wetlands can be found all over in Europe. Everyone has at least heard about this habitat but most know little about it. It is an ancient yet largely unknown set of landscapes that is full of enchanting surprises. On a warm spring day, poisonous adders emerge from hiding to perform their impressive mating dance. As dusk falls, snipe gather on traditional leks, leaping and singing to impress the opposite sex. And deep down in the boggy marshes, glittering emeralds of sticky dew lure insects into the deadly arms of meat-eating plants. Magical Moors captures the quiet beauty of a spectacular landscape, and its often elusive wildlife, in stunning detail.

As dusk falls, snipe gather on traditional leks, leaping and singing to impress the opposite sex. And deep down in the boggy marshes, glittering emeralds of sticky dew lure insects into the deadly arms of meat-eating plants. Magical Moors captures the quiet beauty of a spectacular landscape, and its often elusive wildlife, in stunning detail.

programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El hijo de Lilian murió en un ataque de pánico provocado por unos alumnos de su colegio que dijeron que el ICE estaba en la escuela. Ahora Lilian demanda a Sara y Amaris, las madres de esos niños. Samuel es modelo y fue contratado por la agencia de David, quien presuntamente fue víctima de unos hackers que robaron toda la información privada de sus clientes, afectando entre todos a Samuel, quien debe más de 30 000 dólares.

Ahora Lilian demanda a Sara y Amaris, las madres de esos niños. Samuel es modelo y fue contratado por la agencia de David, quien presuntamente fue víctima de unos hackers que robaron toda la información privada de sus clientes, afectando entre todos a Samuel, quien debe más de 30 000 dólares.

programme.title: Hot Cakes & Hot Takes
programme.desc: Starter homes are getting squeezed while luxury homes and highway builders are doing fine, and the numbers show exactly why this construction story splits in two. Tom walks through luxury builders like Toll Brothers raising guidance with margins around 26 percent, move‑up and entry‑level builders like D.R. Horton and Lennar seeing higher cancellation rates, margin compression and guidance cuts at the starter‑home level, and then shows why highway and civil construction names like Construction Partners, Martin Marietta and Vulcan Materials are booming off federal infrastructure spending.

programme.title: Civil War - A Living History
programme.desc: In the aftermath of the Battle of Gettysburg, General Robert E. Lee and the battered Army of Northern Virginia faced the daunting task of retreating through hostile territory while pursued by Union forces. Retreat from Gettysburg: Lee's Escape explores the dramatic withdrawal across Pennsylvania and Maryland, highlighting the logistical challenges, swollen rivers, wounded soldiers, and strategic decisions that ultimately allowed Lee's army to evade destruction.
